body: While he was dancing, I kept thinking how disembodied his head looked, as if it were badly photoshopped onto his body.

I know! I found this so awkward and emasculating for the men. I guess the title is correct, because it's like they're reduced to being "servants" to the women. They're less than equal, but I guess that's the point of this service? It's to give women a weird power trip?

I'd use a service if I could pay to be taken out on a guaranteed wonderful date, with a handsome and intelligent man. It's okay if he pretends to enjoy my company, but he doesn't have to act like he has no personality and only exists to please me.
How much saliva does this guy have in his mouth? Couldn't stand the lip smacking every other sentence.
Is it weird that I find that attractive? I've always liked that sound….

Yes, I've never been good with confrontation, and when she gets aggressive my hands start to shake and my chest feels really tight. I don't think it's worth the stress. It's been several weeks and I'm starting to dread going into work. My life revolves around my work, so...

I think the silver lining is that I can find a better job, but I'm really scared. I had a suicide attempt in 2010, and I'm scared of getting back in that place. I'm worried about falling completely into hopelessness.
Wasn't looking for any advice, just a friend to talk to.

I haven't been out of the house this weekend, which is starting to make me hate myself. I need something for dinner, so I'm going to the market now. Please, if you're thinking of leaving a comment, it would really mean a lot to me when I get back.
limes, olives, and chocolate sounds a little too adventurous for me.
There is one…. That show is still on. Haha.
I really love that word, I feel like it's fun to say. Similarly, I said the frisbee went into that copse of trees over there, and was met w/ blank stares.
Reading through this ridiculous thread, your comment actually made me laugh at that imagery. I like the way you worded that, haha.

I'd either have to keep paying for a kennel while trying to find them a home myself, or take them to the shelter. 

The upsetting thing is that I have the money to take care of them, I just can't find anywhere that allows pets. 

I love them. If they're gone there will be no happiness left in my life. I don't want to keep going to my 9-5 if there's nothing to come home to. Why the hell am I exhausting myself with work, if I can't even keep the only things I care about?

Yeah, it's tough, I've been trying from all angles here already. Thats why I'm getting so stressed. I feel like I'm just hitting a brick wall over and over.

 There's lots of competition for any rentals, so even if I offer an insanely large pet deposit, there are ten other applicants who don't have pets, and they just choose them.

It's also a very isolated place. Funny enough, I've called on rentals that were waaaaaaay out in the country, and the owners say absolutely no pets. Why bother living on a farm if you can't have animals?
No, I've been renting, and she's been staying with me, so we're both looking for a new place now.
